_note: Single source of product facts for the site, schema, llms.txt, lints and prompts. Public App Store data only. scripts/check-facts.mjs compares it with the live US listing; it may rewrite only rating.* and only when the 1-decimal value or rating.show flips (show = value >= 4.5 and count >= 20). A change in storeName or minIOS needs a human because copy depends on it. storeUrl keeps the slug the repo CLAUDE.md documents; Apple 301s it to the current slug (quran-widget-quranwall) and keeps pt and ct (checked 2026-11-16). downloadsFloor/downloadsAsOf: a lower bound on total downloads from App Store Connect (a private count, confirmed by the ASO session), not in the public listing; the only allowed download claim is "Downloaded <downloadsFloor> times" (scripts/lint-facts.mjs rule social-proof-downloads), and any other user or download count is a FAIL. Raise the floor and the date together when the count grows.
installLine: Free to download, with an in-app subscription.
